external_entities.name: store manager
external_entities.description: A manager who uses the scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.

external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who uses the scheduling web app to look at assigned shifts and reaches it from their own phone.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues use the same app to look at the shifts they have been given.

external_entities.name: payroll system
external_entities.description: The payroll system, run by another team, collects the payroll export from the file share.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.

processes.name: scheduling web app
processes.description: A web application used by store managers to build weekly rotas and by colleagues to view assigned shifts.
processes.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.
processes.notes: Authentication, identification of the scheduling service, and encryption are undocumented.

processes.name: scheduling service
processes.description: A service that reads and writes rotas and writes a weekly payroll export.
processes.source_excerpt: The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas, which live in a rota database.
processes.notes: Authentication, identification of communicating systems, and encryption are undocumented.

data_stores.name: rota database
data_stores.description: A database containing rotas, colleague names, contact details, and stated availability.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Colleague names, contact details and stated availability are held in that database.

data_stores.name: file share
data_stores.description: A file share receiving a weekly payroll export from the scheduling service.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Once a week the scheduling service writes a payroll export onto a file share.

data_flows.name: build rota
data_flows.description: A store manager uses the scheduling web app to build the weekly rota.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.
data_flows.notes: How store managers sign in is undocumented; encryption is undocumented.

data_flows.name: look at shifts
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the scheduling web app to view assigned shifts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues use the same app to look at the shifts they have been given.
data_flows.notes: How colleagues sign in is undocumented; encryption is undocumented.

data_flows.name: talks
data_flows.description: The scheduling web app communicates with the scheduling service.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web app talks to a scheduling service.
data_flows.notes: How the web app and scheduling service identify each other is undocumented; encryption is undocumented.

data_flows.name: read-write rotas
data_flows.description: The scheduling service reads and writes rotas in the rota database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas, which live in a rota database.
data_flows.notes: How the scheduling service identifies itself to the database and whether the interaction is encrypted are undocumented.

data_flows.name: write payroll export
data_flows.description: The scheduling service writes a weekly payroll export to the file share.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once a week the scheduling service writes a payroll export onto a file share.
data_flows.notes: How the scheduling service identifies itself to the file share and whether the interaction is encrypted are undocumented.

data_flows.name: collect export
data_flows.description: The payroll system collects the payroll export from the file share.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.
data_flows.notes: How the payroll system is identified when it collects the export and whether the interaction is encrypted are undocumented.

trust_boundaries.name: internal network
trust_boundaries.description: The internal network containing the scheduling service, rota database, and file share.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The scheduling service, the rota database and the file share are on the internal network.

assumptions.assumption: The rota database's stated contents are personally identifiable information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database holds colleague names, contact details and stated availability.

assumptions.assumption: The rota database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The database holds colleague names, contact details and stated availability; disclosure of these personal details would harm individuals.

assumptions.assumption: The payroll file share holds financial data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the scheduling service writes a payroll export to the file share.

assumptions.assumption: The payroll file share contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The file share holds a payroll export, which contains commercially or personally sensitive payroll information.
